topics.label: Introduction to Cancer Evolution and Microenvironmental Factors
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session's overarching focus on cancer development through Darwinian evolution, cellular predispositions, and microenvironmental interactions.

topics.label: Genetic Selection and Epigenetic Drivers of Clonal Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cell-intrinsic alterations through sequential genetic mutations and epigenetic chromatin modifications confer competitive fitness and selective advantages to evolving cell clones.

topics.label: Cell of Origin and Stem Cell Hierarchies in Tumor Initiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tissue hierarchies and the inherent self-renewal properties of stem or progenitor cells determine susceptibility to malignant transformation.

topics.label: Role of the Microenvironment and Inflammation in Tumor Promotion
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how external environmental stimuli, inflammatory signaling, and supportive stromal interactions cooperate with cellular mutations to permit and sustain malignant outgrowth.

topics.label: Technologies for Investigating Clonal and Spatial Tumor Dynamics
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic reviews the experimental and computational technologies used to map the timing, transcriptional states, and spatial architecture of tumor cells and their microenvironments.

topics.label: Multifactorial Evolutionary Synthesis of Cancer Progression
topics.groupedBecause: The subtopic synthesizes the lecture by integrating cellular origin, genetic burden, epigenetic plasticity, and microenvironmental conditions into a unified evolutionary model of malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the lecture and previews the upcoming session on cancer therapies.
